verdict.rationale: Crossmint is payments and wallet infrastructure exposed as APIs for developers to call; it is not an AI host or agent client that consumes tools from external MCP servers. Nothing in the evidence shows the product acting as an MCP client. The AI-assistant docs material (docs-20, docs-36) is about feeding Crossmint's docs into other tools, which is the opposite role. Plugging MCP servers into it is therefore a category error for this product type.
